topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 77 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 30 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs, 3 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 26 common project-authored base contract(s) (storage, nodelegatecall, abstractfiattokenv1). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
